title: SEO Setup
description: Standard SEO configuration for launch-ready WordPress sites.

steps.title: Set Post Name Permalinks
steps.instructions: Change permalink structure to Post name (/%postname%/) unless a custom structure is required for the content model.

steps.title: Enable Search Indexing
steps.instructions: On production, uncheck 'Discourage search engines' in Settings → Reading. Keep it checked on staging.

steps.title: Install & Configure SEO Plugin
steps.instructions: Install Yoast, Rank Math, or SEOPress. Set site name, separator, default social image, and noindex rules for thin pages.

steps.title: Enable XML Sitemap
steps.instructions: Enable the SEO plugin sitemap or core sitemap. Exclude admin, cart, and internal search result URLs.

steps.title: Add Organization Schema
steps.instructions: Configure Organization or LocalBusiness schema with logo, name, URL, and contact details in the SEO plugin or theme settings.

steps.title: Fix Duplicate URLs
steps.instructions: Redirect www/non-www and HTTP to HTTPS consistently. Resolve trailing-slash and pagination canonical issues.

steps.title: Verify Search Console Property
steps.instructions: Add and verify the domain in Google Search Console. Submit the XML sitemap and check for coverage errors.
